newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Howard sees smaller budget saving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Howard sees smaller budget saving.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard repeated on Thursday that savings to be announced in the 1997/98 (June 30) budget in May would be much less than those in the 1996/97 budget announced last August.
"The savings we've got to achieve this year are much less than the savings that we achieved in the last budget," Howard told Sydney Radio 2GB.
"If you have another budget that reduces the deficit then the prospects for the economy are made better," Howard said.

Treasurer Peter Costello announced last month in a mid-year economic review a revised forecast for the 1996/97 underlying deficit of A$8.49 billion, compared with the A$5.65 billion forecast in the August budget.
He said further budget tightening would therefore be needed if the government were to balance its books by 1998/99, as planned.
